Terms & Conditions

Last Updated: January 10, 2026

1. Bespoke Services

Nokon Bespoke specializes in fully custom-made clothing, crafted individually to your specifications, measurements, and preferences. Each garment is unique, handcrafted from selected fabrics, and involves multiple stages including consultation, measurement, pattern drafting, fittings, and final production.

The process typically takes 2 to 8 weeks, depending on complexity, fabric availability, and fitting requirements. We will provide an estimated timeline during consultation.

2. Ordering Process

Consultation and Measurements: An initial consultation (in-person or virtual) is required to discuss design, fabric selection, styling, and measurements. You are responsible for providing accurate measurements if taken remotely or self-submitted.

Payment: A non-refundable deposit of 50% of the total price is required to commence work. We accept cash transfers, direct bank deposits, or cash payments in person. All payments are made in Nigerian Naira.

Approval: You will approve designs, fabrics, and details before production begins. Changes after approval may incur additional costs.

Fittings: Multiple fittings (usually 2-3) are included. Additional fittings may incur extra charges.

Communication: We will keep you informed of progress. Please respond promptly to messages to avoid delays.

3. Pricing and Payment

Prices are quoted individually based on design complexity, fabric choice, and customization.

Full payment (we only accept cash transfer or cash deposit or one-on-one) is required before final delivery, or as agreed in stages.

Prices include VAT where applicable and are subject to change for fabric costs or specifications.

Payments are non-refundable except as specified in these Terms.

4. Cancellations and Refunds

Garments are custom-made to your exact specifications and are exempt from standard distance selling cancellation rights.

Cancellations: Orders cannot be cancelled after the deposit is paid and work has commenced, as fabrics are cut and labor invested specifically for you.

Refunds: Deposits and payments are non-refundable. In exceptional circumstances (e.g., our inability to complete the garment), we may offer a partial refund or credit at our discretion.

5. Fit and Alterations

We guarantee a professional fit based on accurate measurements and fittings attended.

Minor alterations post-delivery are included for a limited period (3 months). Major changes due to client body changes or preference shifts are chargeable.

If measurements are client-provided (remote orders), we offer a remake policy for manufacturing errors only, subject to return of the original garment.

6. Delivery and Collection

Garments are delivered or available for collection once final payment is received. Delivery costs and risks are borne by you unless agreed otherwise.

Delays due to fabric supply, fittings, or unforeseen issues are not grounds for cancellation or refund.

7. Care and Liability

Garments require professional dry cleaning or care as advised.

We are not liable for damage from improper care, wear and tear, or client alterations.

Our liability is limited to the value of the garment. We exclude liability for consequential losses.

8. Intellectual Property

Patterns created for you remain our property but are stored for future orders. Designs are for personal use; commercial reproduction is prohibited.

9. Force Majeure

We are not liable for delays or failures due to events beyond our control like supply chain issues, or natural disasters.

10. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of Nigeria. Any disputes shall be resolved in the Federal High Court, the Competition and Consumer Protection Tribunal.

11. Changes to Terms

We may update these Terms; continued use of our services constitutes acceptance.

Privacy Policy for Nokon Bespoke

Last Updated: January 10, 2026

Nokon Bespoke respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website, make a purchase, or otherwise interact with our bespoke fashion services.

Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. By using our services, you agree to the practices described here. If you do not agree, please do not use our website or services.

1. Information We Collect

Personal Information You Provide

When you place an order or contact us, we may collect:

  • Name, email address, phone number, and delivery address
  • Body measurements and preferences for bespoke tailoring
  • Any other details you voluntarily provide (e.g., style preferences or feedback)

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Process and fulfill orders, including bespoke stitching and delivery
  • Communicate with you about orders, updates, fittings scheduling or inquiries
  • Provide customer support
  • Send promotional messages or emails (you can opt out at any time)
  • Improve our website, products, and services
  • Prevent fraud and ensure security
  • Comply with legal obligations

3. Sharing Your Information

We may share your information with:

  • Service providers (e.g., delivery companies, network providers, email services) who help operate our business
  • Analytics and marketing partners (in anonymized or aggregated form where possible)
  • Legal authorities if required by law

We do not sell your personal information to third parties for their marketing purposes.

4. Data Security

We implement reasonable security measures, including encryption for sensitive data, to protect your information. However, no system is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. Be security vigilant.

5. Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services and as required by law. Measurement data is retained to facilitate future orders and alterations. You may request deletion of your data, except where we are reuired to ratain it for legal or business purposes.

6. Your Rights and Choices

Depending on your location, you may have rights to:

  • Access, correct, or delete your personal information

Requests should be forwarded to WhatsApp. We respond to requests within applicable legal timelines.

7. Children's Privacy

Our services are not intended for individuals under 18. However it can be made through an adult consultation. We do not knowingly collect data from minors.

8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy. Changes will be posted here with the updated date. Significant changes will be notified via email, social media or site notice.

9. Contact Us

For questions or to exercise your rights:
